signIn.notSetUpTitle: Trybun is not set up yet

administration.title: Administration
administration.allDone: Everything on this list is set up.

create_project.title: Create a project
create_project.description: Create the first project and add the team to it.

configure_github_sign_in.title: Configure GitHub sign-in
configure_github_sign_in.description: Team members sign in with GitHub. Required before you can invite the team.

configure_email.title: Configure e-mail
configure_email.description: Without an SMTP server Trybun sends no e-mail, so invitation links have to be passed on by hand.

configure_backup_storage.title: Configure backup storage
configure_backup_storage.description: Without S3 storage in another location, the daily backups are kept only on this server and are lost with it.

create.name: Name
create.keyDescription: 2–10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter, e.g. ERP.

projects.archivedBanner: This project is archived and read-only.

general.readOnly: Only the Administrator changes the name and the key.
general.confirmResolutionDescription: Ask the requester to confirm that the problem is solved.

members.title: Members
members.empty: The project has no members yet.
members.addDescription: Add an active team member to the project.
members.search: Search by name or GitHub login
members.lastManagerWarning: This project will have no Project manager. The Administrator covers the role.

danger.archiveDescription: The project becomes read-only for everyone, the Administrator included, until it is unarchived.
danger.unarchiveDescription: The project can be changed again.
danger.deleteDescription: Deletes the project and its memberships. This cannot be undone.
danger.deleteArchived: Unarchive the project before you delete it.

setup.title: Set up Trybun
setup.intro: Create the first Administrator account. You set up two-factor authentication when you sign in for the first time.
setup.invalidTitle: This setup link is invalid or has expired
setup.invalidText: Run <command>./trybun setup-token</command> on the server for a new link.
setup.passwordDescription: At least {min} characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember. You sign in with this password and a one-time code from an authenticator app.
setup.systemDefaults: Default language of the system: {language}; default time zone: {timeZone}. Both are set in <file>.env</file> and changed there, followed by <command>docker compose up -d --wait</command>.
setup.doneText: Sign in with your e-mail address and password. Trybun then asks you to set up two-factor authentication with an authenticator app.
